Ruling: use fixed1634fc2 archives plus owned overlays in the shared checkout — preserve concurrent WIP and keep test inputs stable — cost if wrong: later shared changes are not covered by this stage.

Ruling: reject inconsistent delivery/head device endpoints even across an unaccepted registration sharing the target device ID — otherwise corrupted target copies can hide under a peer head — cost if wrong: malformed data in a reused device may block cleanup until repaired, but deletion never broadens beyond accepted pairs.
